redfin.remarks: This urban oasis is the ideal place to retreat in prime Hollywood. This townhome-style condo features wood floors, an updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances, newer HVAC, and in-unit washer and dryer. Located on the upper floor is the spacious primary bedroom with vaulted ceiling, walk-in closet, en-suite bathroom and a lovely patio perfect for the morning's first cup of coffee or tea. The guest bedroom, also on the upper floor, has its own a private patio with picture perfect views of the Hollywood Hills. This home is in the middle of everything. Spend Sundays strolling the famous Hollywood Farmer's Market, stop by Groundwork Coffee, Stout, Mama Shelter or a number of other local favorites. Two side-by-side parking spaces and easy access to the 101 freeway make daily LA living and commuting that much easier.
